title: Google’s New AI Tool Is Crazy Powerful (Here’s How to Profit)
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: Host promotes his own HighLevel done-for-you setup service at the end and uses affiliate-style tools (Lindy, Outscraper, HighLevel)

stated_problem.quote: There are 2 million real estate agents in America and about 70% of them list homes for sale that either have bad pictures or pictures of homes that aren't staged.
stated_problem.speaker: Chris Koerner

idea.name: AI virtual staging and photo enhancement for estate agents
idea.one_liner: Vibe-code a private web app on Google's Nano Banana (Gemini image) API, grab unstaged photos from live listings, add furniture or DSLR-style polish, and text the free mock-up to the listing agent via a HighLevel automation to win paid work
idea.customer: residential real estate agents with unstaged or poorly photographed listings
idea.revenue_model: ~$1 per photo to start, later ~$500/month unlimited plan

key_quotes.quote: And then I'm going to proactively give these pictures for free to the listing agent.
You've got a 96% profit margin cuz you're charging a dollar and you're paying 4.
Maybe she joins a monthly recurring plan for 500 bucks a month for unlimited revisions to unstaged photos.
There could be a thousand of these agencies that just edits photos for real estate agents, and there'd still be room for everyone.

claims.quote: Furthermore, homes that are staged when they're listed for sale sell for 6 to 10% more.

claims.claim: Editing one image costs about 3.9 cents
claims.quote: Now, as long as your prompt is not too complex, which mine will not be, it costs about 3.9 to edit one picture.

claims.claim: Scrape yielded 542 Oklahoma City agents with mobile numbers
claims.quote: Okay, we are left with 562 real estate agents in Oklahoma City that have cell phone numbers.

acquisition_channels.details: Outscraper Google Maps scrape of agents' mobiles, imported to HighLevel; uploading the edited photo triggers an SMS with the mock-up link and a follow-up pipeline

ideas.delivery: Lindy vibe-coded web app calling Gemini Nano Banana API; manual photo selection from Zillow; HighLevel CRM workflows

uk_legal_risk.reason: Unsolicited marketing texts to scraped mobiles of agents (many sole traders/individuals) breach PECR without consent

ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR for scraped personal data; copyright in listing photos; misleading virtual staging can breach the Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act unfair-practice rules and NTSELAT material-information guidance unless clearly labelled
